stem.text: What is meant by the efficiency of a system?

A.text: the total energy input to the system divided by the useful energy output by the system

B.text: the useful energy output from the system divided by the energy wasted by the system

C.text: the useful energy output from the system divided by the total energy input to the system

D.text: the energy wasted by the system divided by the total energy input to the system
